## Beta — Native entity picker is back

The entity field in the rule dialog uses Home Assistant's own entity picker again (search by name or id, friendly names, icons) instead of a plain text box with browser suggestions. The plain text field with suggestions is kept as an automatic fallback: it is used if the native picker is not available or fails to render.

Domain include/exclude options of the card still apply to the picker.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.4.0-beta2...v1.4.0-beta3
